description: This file implements and manages the loose object index mapping system within a Git repository, including reading, writing, inserting, and retrieving object ID mappings, as well as initializing and clearing the map structures.

methods.name: void loose_object_map_init(struct loose_object_map ** map)
methods.description: Initializes the loose_object_map structure with new hash maps.

methods.name: int insert_oid_pair(kh_oid_map_t * map,const struct object_id * key,const struct object_id * value)
methods.description: Inserts a pair of object IDs into the specified hash map.

methods.name: int insert_loose_map(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Inserts object ID and compatibility object ID pairs into the loose map and updates the cache.

methods.name: int load_one_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo,struct odb_source * source)
methods.description: Loads the loose object map for a repository source from disk, parsing the index file.

methods.name: int repo_read_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Reads loose object maps for all repository sources if applicable.

methods.name: int repo_write_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Writes the loose object map index to disk.

methods.name: int write_one_object(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Helper to write a single object and its compatibility mapping to the index file.

methods.name: int repo_add_loose_object_map(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Adds an object map entry and writes the update if needed.

methods.name: int repo_loose_object_map_oid(struct repository * repo,const struct object_id * src,const struct git_hash_algo * to,struct object_id * dest)
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID mapping for a given source object ID, using the specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: void loose_object_map_clear(struct loose_object_map ** map)
methods.description: Clears and frees the loose object map structure.
